An always-on long-L floor NMOS guarantees oscillation at 0.7 V in ss/-40C. Budget at tt mid: I0=20uA x2 branches plus ring 80uA, about 0.22mW; ff/1.98V stays under 0.75mW. Three stages with small nodes (~10fF) give ~1GHz at tt and >470MHz at ss/125C. The buffer restores rail-to-rail swing."}

PARAMS = {
    "I0":    (22e-6, 8e-6, 60e-6),     # reference branch current at mid vctrl (tt)
    "k":     (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),          # starving current / I0
    "gmid":  (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),         # gm/Id of mirror/starving devices
    "Lm":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),         # L of mirror/starving devices
    "ffl":   (0.2, 0.05, 0.4),         # floor-current fraction of I0 (always-on)
    "Wn":    (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),         # ring inverter NMOS width
    "pn":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.5),          # ring inverter PMOS/NMOS width ratio
    "Cx":    (1e-15, 0.1e-15, 30e-15), # extra cap per ring node (tuning)
    "Wb":    (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),         # output buffer final NMOS width
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vlo, vhi = spec.get("vctrl_range", [0.7, 1.4])
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    I0 = p["I0"]; Ist = p["k"] * I0; L = p["Lm"]; g = p["gmid"]
    Ifl = p["ffl"] * I0

    # --- floor device: gate at vdd, long L, sized for Ifl at 1.8 V
    Lf = 2.0
    idw_f = lut.op("n", 1.0, Lf, 1.8, 0.6)["Id"]
    Wf = max(0.42, Ifl / max(idw_f, 1e-12))
    # --- control device: gate vctrl, supplies I0 - Ifl at vmid
    Lc = 0.5
    idw_c = lut.op("n", 1.0, Lc, vmid, 0.6)["Id"]
    Wc = max(0.42, (I0 - Ifl) / max(idw_c, 1e-12))

    # --- mirrors
    mpd = lut.size("p", g, L, I0, vds=1.0)        # PMOS diode (pb)
    mp2 = lut.size("p", g, L, I0, vds=0.8)        # PMOS mirror -> NMOS diode
    mnd = lut.size("n", g, L, I0, vds=0.8)        # NMOS diode (nb)
    mps = lut.size("p", g, L, Ist, vds=0.35)      # top starving
    mns = lut.size("n", g, L, Ist, vds=0.35)      # bottom starving

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    n.M("MC", "pb", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wc, Lc)
    n.M("MF", "pb", "vdd", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wf, Lf)
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("MP2", "nb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp2)
    n.dev("MND", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mnd)

    Wn = p["Wn"]; Wp = p["pn"] * Wn; Li = 0.15
    N = 3
    x = ["x0", "x1", "x2"]
    for i in range(N):
        a, b = x[i], x[(i + 1) % N]
        n.dev(f"MPS{i}", f"sp{i}", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mps)
        n.M(f"MPI{i}", b, a, f"sp{i}", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Li)
        n.M(f"MNI{i}", b, a, f"sn{i}", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Li)
        n.dev(f"MNS{i}", f"sn{i}", "nb", "vss", "vss", mns)
        n.C(f"CX{i}", b, "vss", p["Cx"])

    # --- output buffer (2 inverters) restores rail-to-rail swing, isolates CL
    Wb = p["Wb"]
    n.M("MB1P", "y1", "x0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 1.0, Li)
    n.M("MB1N", "y1", "x0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.5, Li)
    n.M("MB2P", "vout", "y1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.0 * Wb, Li)
    n.M("MB2N", "vout", "y1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, Li)

    # --- first-order predictions
    cox = 8.5e-15                           # ~F/um^2 effective
    cg_inv = (Wn + Wp) * Li * cox + (Wn + Wp) * 0.35e-15
    cd_inv = (Wn + Wp) * 0.6e-15
    Cnode = cg_inv + cd_inv + p["Cx"] + 2e-15
    vdd = 1.8
    f_mid = Ist / (N * Cnode * vdd)
    Cb = 1.5 * 0.6e-15 + 3 * Wb * 0.6e-15 + 10e-15
    power = vdd * (2 * I0 + Ist) + Cb * vdd ** 2 * f_mid
    return n, {"f_mid": f_mid, "power": power, "swing": 0.95 * vdd}
